scope: Controlled Store cache and actual fresh authority-admission calls only; no runtime media quality or transport-cell claim.
problem: The optimistic path admits old scope names then compares only the first same-source memo entry against an arbitrary available SQL observer. A different observer can already have exact current cached metadata, yet the path discards its fresh file reader and repeats admission before using that metadata.

discarded_initial_run.reason: Formatting overlapped source inventory; source guard false, excluded from proof. Retained privately.

required_behavior: Use only a memo entry matching the actual currently owned SQL observer, exact complete Version and original source identity.
The newly admitted file reader must cover that selected entry complete scopes before seal and finish.
Changed data/schema/policy clock, changed scope/source, contention, ownership, file privacy or queued writers still require original fresh checks or refusal.
Do not add positive authority caching, retain SQL during file admission, expand pools, renew packet deadlines or retry uncertain IO.
